title: Gemini Decisions API (gemini-decision-1): can it name which held Product Hunt people upvote which launches?
written: 2026-11-22, after the API answers were collected and before any scoring code was run
people: Eligible for day D (E5 backer-prediction rule): complete person, first upvote read before 00:00 PT of D, an upvote read after D closed. Per day 150 random eligible backers (upvoted >= 1 of D's launches) + 150 random eligible active non-backers (no vote on D's launches, >= 1 upvote on a launch dated in the 30 days before D). Seed 20261122. 900 person-days.
lineup: Every launch in the warehouse launches table dated D: name, tagline, topics, hunter's earlier launches (count, median final votes, launches dated before D only).
labels: Launch post id is on the person's own Upvotes tab (raw record).
input: Join month; upvote counts on launches from the 7 and 30 days before D; 60 most recent upvotes before D (launch date, name, tagline, topics where held); up to 8 comments written before D (200 chars, @mentions masked); the day's line-up. Same input for API and baseline.
leak_checks: history items: launch date < D, asserted
history items sit below the oldest Upvotes-tab item whose launch date >= D (tab is newest first), so upvotes cast after the person's first vote on a launch dated >= D are dropped
comments: exact time before 00:00 PT of D, asserted
hunter track record: launches dated before D only
baseline weights fitted on Nov 12-16 only
api: One call per person-day, one noul question per launch: 'Would this person upvote "<name>" (<tagline>) on Product Hunt today?'. P = answers.<key>.noul. One prompt, one pass, no tuning.
baseline: Logistic regression on log1p(upvotes 7d), log1p(upvotes 30d), topic overlap, log1p(hunter earlier launches), log1p(hunter median votes), line-up size; fitted on Nov 12-16 with the same sampling (200 backers + 200 active non-backers per day).

metrics.ci: bootstrap over people (2000 draws; a person's person-days resampled together); API minus baseline paired on the same draws
metrics.primary: AUC of P(upvote) over all person-launch pairs, pooled over 3 days
metrics.brier: Brier score + decile calibration table (50/50 backer sampling sets base rate, same for both arms)
metrics.recall_at_N: per launch, within day: rank the 300 sampled people by P, top N = that launch's sampled backers; pooled hits / sum N. E5's ~29% is on all held people, context only.
secondary: within-person AUC for backers (does P order the launches they picked above the rest)
API after leave-one-day-out Platt scaling (fitted on the other two test days)

verdict_rule: Worth running daily only if the API beats the baseline on AUC and on recall at N with the paired interval clear of 0, at a cost the daily budget absorbs.
